bill.title: Virtual Currency Kiosk Consumer Protection Act.

posted_text:
💰 NC HB 920 — NC Creates Rules for Digital Asset Kiosks

North Carolina is establishing rules for digital asset kiosks, limiting new customers to $2,000 in daily transactions and requiring refunds for fraudulent activity. This new law aims to protect consumers using digital assets and ensures kiosks operate within a regulated framework for digital currency transmissions.

July 2, 2026: Ratified.
